insurance_premium_prediction_model.title: Insurance Premium Prediction Model
insurance_premium_prediction_model.content:
**[Try out](https://insurance-premium-prediction-model.vercel.app/)**
### **What?**
A machine learning model that predicts user's insurance premiums based on their basic details.
## **Why?**
I wanted to step my foot into the world of machine learning and data science, and this project was a great way to apply those skills in a practical way. This gives me an idea that how big is the sea.
## Techs
### **Model** - Scikit-learn | NumPy | Pandas | Python
### **Frontend** - React | TypeScript
### **API** - FastAPI | Pydantic
## **Rating by me** : ⭐ **3.5/5**

globe_travel_history.title: The Places I Traveled
globe_travel_history.content:
🔗 **Introduction**

Travelling is that thread in my life that is directly connected to my soul. It gives me a different kind of happiness.I love to inhale the calmness, the busyness, the people, and their culture. I always wonder what Mother Nature wanted to create there. As I travel, I begin to relate everything with all the knowledge I've gathered throughout my life. I hope one day I'll go far beyond my own imagination.

### **Journeys & Realizations**

🏔️ **Kedarnath (Uttarakhand)** `(June 2025)` 
- **Watch Journey:** [View Video Clip](https://youtube.com)
- **Realization:** Calmness never needed to prove himself.

🌿 **Dooars (Siliguri & Moynaguri)** `(June 2026)`
- **Watch Journey:** [View Video Clip](https://youtube.com)
- **Realization:**Even Nature needs a door to separate itself from greed.

🙏 **Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir (Ayodhya)** `(July 2025)`
- **Watch Journey:** [View Video Clip](https://youtube.com)
- **Realization:** Belive in your knowledge and in your soul's god, never allow one to define your soul.

🌊 **Jagannath Temple (Puri, Odisha)** `(Oct 2025)`
- **Watch Journey:** [View Video Clip](https://youtube.com)
- **Realization:** there exists a divine power that can lift one up from confusion, misery, melancholy and failure, and guide one to one’s true place.

🧱 **Pakur (Jharkhand)** `(Jan 2026)`
- **Watch Journey:** [View Video Clip](https://youtube.com)
- **Realization:** Mother Nature might makes human to balance the universe not the earth.
